title: Hilton Head Speed Boat Tours
specs: Hilton Head Skiff Guided Boat Tour: minimum 2 guests per booking.
All boat captains on the tour must be at least 18 years of age and have a valid drivers license.
Minimum age is 5 years old to ride with a valid operator with no maximum age, although you must be able to get on and off your boat unassisted.

services.name: Hilton Head Skiff Guided Boat Tour
services.desc: 25+ mile excursion through salt marsh and local waterways! Adults (ages 13 and up) - $145 Children (ages 5-12) - $125 2 hours and 15 minutes About Do you want to try something exciting and different on Hilton Head Island this year? Come join us while we explore Hilton Head, Bluffton, Daufuskie, and other surrounding islands on a 25 – 30-mile dolphin watch and drive-it-yourself boat tour. On our Hilton Head dolphin tour, we make stops for dolphins, talk about interesting history, and see great sights along the way. Our guides lead the way in a separate but identical boat while Starting at $125 · Ages 5+ · 2 Hour 15 Min · 25+ Mile Excursion

includes: We provide ice water and dry storage on each guided boat tour of Hilton Head.
We provide a 6-pack cooler with water and you may bring snacks if you wish.
gap: Cancellations will not be accepted within 48 hour window prior to trip. If you need to cancel please call (843) 816-5976.
blurb: Join us for an unforgettable dolphin watch tour where you get to drive your own two-person CraigCat catamaran or skiff-style boat through the beautiful creeks and coastal waters around Hilton Head Island.
